notes.title: Stat scene update B5
notes.notes:
Game Update:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536006/ba4f253ad7fc01ebe895704ee3770b6f73aefdde.png

     Added a new Stats Screen, accessible by pressing the associated button ("Stats").
     Improved UI design: the center panel is now color-coded to enhance visibility.
     Adjusted the background so now it's visible when objects are moving, creating a better sense of depth.
     Overhauled the save/load system—all save files are now stored in a single folder. This should make Steam Cloud integration possible, though further testing is needed.
